blocks.plainText: In Areas A, C and E, all developments that are located on a zoning lot with frontage along Emmons Avenue, except for a zoning lot of less than 8,000 square feet that was in existence as of November 1, 1972, shall provide and maintain a plaza for public use which complies with the following requirements:

blocks.html: (a)        The plaza shall abut the Emmons Avenue street line along the full length of such lot line or for a distance of at least 50 feet, whichever is less.
blocks.plainText: (a) The plaza shall abut the Emmons Avenue street line along the full length of such lot line or for a distance of at least 50 feet, whichever is less.

blocks.html: (b)        The plaza shall be directly accessible to the public at all times from Emmons Avenue or a plaza.
blocks.plainText: (b) The plaza shall be directly accessible to the public at all times from Emmons Avenue or a plaza.

blocks.html: (c)        The size of the plaza shall be at least 4,000 square feet in one location with a minimum dimension of 35 feet, and shall comply with the provisions of Section 94-20 (DESIGN REQUIREMENTS FOR PLAZAS).
